description: How far the golfer is from the flag, from where they are standing. Pass their lat and lng. Returns the course, the hole, its par and stroke index, and yards to the flag (today's pin as the club set it) and to the middle of the green. When hole_inferred is true the hole was chosen from the position, so say which hole you assumed. No account needed.

accuracy_m.description: Optional. The location's horizontal accuracy in meters, when the device reports it.

course.description: Optional. The course slug, when known. Otherwise the course is found from the position.

hole.description: Optional. The hole number the golfer says they are on. Otherwise the hole is chosen from the position.

lat.description: The golfer's latitude, from their phone or glasses.

name: distance_to_flag
title: Distance to the flag
